summary: Berbérati Airport (BBT/FEFT) is a medium-sized regional airport serving the city of Berbérati, the capital of Mambéré-Kadéï prefecture in the southwestern Central African Republic. Located near the border with Cameroon, it functions as a key access point for travelers visiting the lush, forested region of the country. The airport supports primarily domestic and limited regional connectivity in an area where road infrastructure can be challenging.
faqs:
Q: What is the airport code for Berbérati Airport?
A: The IATA code is BBT and the ICAO code is FEFT.

Q: Where is Berbérati Airport located?
A: It is located in the city of Berbérati in the Mambéré-Kadéï prefecture of the Central African Republic, near the border with Cameroon.

Q: Are there international flights from Berbérati Airport?
A: The airport primarily handles domestic and some regional flights, with limited international service to neighboring countries.

Q: What is the size of Berbérati Airport?
A: It is classified as a medium-sized airport serving regional air traffic in the southwestern part of the country.
transport_tips: Getting to and from Berbérati Airport is typically done by road, with the airport located a short drive from the city center. Taxi and moto-taxi services are commonly available, though it's advisable to arrange transport in advance. The road connecting the airport to town may become difficult to navigate during the rainy season, so allow extra travel time accordingly.
local_tip: Carry cash in CFA francs for ground transportation and any on-site fees, as card payment facilities are rarely available at this regional airport.
